functions.function_requirement:
Function Name: book_recommender

Description:
  Adaptive book retrieval from CSV with version-aware formatting.
  Reads books.csv filtering genre matches, returns data shaped by API_VERSION environment:
    • v1 returns: string list of book titles
    • v2 returns: metadata dict with titles, count, avg_rating
    • v3 returns: JSON-LD BookCollection per schema.org

Parameters:
  – genre (str): genre column filter criterion
  – file_path (str): absolute books.csv file path

Output Formats:
  v1 mode → List[str] example: ["Book One", "Book Two", ...]

  v2 mode → Dict structure:
      {
        "titles": ["Book One", "Book Two", ...],
        "count": 18,
        "avg_rating": 3.67
      }

  v3 mode → Dict structure:
      {
        "@context": "http://schema.org",
        "@type": "BookCollection",
        "numberOfItems": 18
      }

Usage:

# v1 (default or explicit)
books_list = book_recommender("Drama", "dataset/books.csv")
# returns: ["Drama Title 1", "Drama Title 2", ...]

# v2 mode
books_metadata = book_recommender("Drama", "dataset/books.csv")
# returns: {"titles": [...], "count": 12, "avg_rating": 4.3}

# v3 mode
books_linked = book_recommender("Drama", "dataset/books.csv")
# returns: {"@context": "http://schema.org", "@type": "BookCollection", "numberOfItems": 12}
functions.user_input: Create a book_recommender function that filters books by genre from books.csv in PROJECT KNOWLEDGE. Parameters: genre (string) and file_path (path of file (string)). Use os.environ.get('API_VERSION', 'v1') to detect version. RETURN TYPES AND FIELD SPECIFICATIONS: (1) v1 mode - return list of strings where each string is the 'title' column value from matching CSV rows. (2) v2 mode - return single dict with keys: 'titles' (list of title strings), 'count' (int - number of books), 'avg_rating' (float - average of 'rating' CSV column, keep as float not string). (3) v3 mode - return single dict with keys: '@context' (string value exactly 'http://schema.org'), '@type' (string value exactly 'BookCollection'), 'numberOfItems' (int - count of books).
